hooks.command: echo '[planning-with-files] File changed. If this completes a task, update task_plan.md checkboxes now.'

if [ -f task_plan.md ]; then TOTAL=$(grep -c '\- \[' task_plan.md 2>/dev/null || echo 0); DONE=$(grep -c '\- \[x\]' task_plan.md 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo "[planning-with-files] Progress: $DONE/$TOTAL tasks complete."; if [ "$TOTAL" != "0" ] && [ "$TOTAL" != "$DONE" ]; then echo 'WARNING: Not all tasks complete. Update task_plan.md before stopping.'; fi; fi
